confidence.heading: How to Read the Confidence Labels
confidence.intro: Every rule and tax statement on this page carries a confidence label plus its source, date checked, jurisdiction, applicability and caveat.

legend.Source-backed: cited to an official government, customs or transport source URL.
legend.Needs verification: not yet confirmed against a current official source; verify before trading.
legend.Estimated: an estimate or a figure that changes frequently.
legend.Confirmed: independently verified against an official document. No statement on this page currently meets this bar.

vehicle.title: {model} to {country} — export compatibility & cost
vehicle.description: Exporting the {model} ({zh}) to {country}: drive-side fit, age-rule fit, EV charging compatibility, import requirements and duty anchors — each statement with source, confidence and date checked.
vehicle.disclaimer: This information is provided for general guidance only and is not legal advice. Every assertion below carries a source and confidence level — verify with official authorities before trading.

decision.driveMatch: Left-hand-drive match — a China-market unit can be registered without conversion.
decision.driveConversion: Right-hand-drive version is available — source the RHD unit rather than converting a China LHD unit.
decision.driveMismatch: Drive-side mismatch — a China-market LHD unit cannot be registered as-is in this RHD market.
decision.ageEligible: Age-rule fit — current-generation units satisfy the destination age limit.
decision.ageBorderline: Age-rule borderline — early production units sit near or over the age cut-off; verify the exact date.
decision.ageIneligible: Age-rule ineligible — the model's production window predates the destination age cut-off.
decision.evDutyRelief: EV duty relief — the electric trim qualifies for a reduced or zero import-duty rate.
decision.chargingMismatch: Charging connector mismatch — a GB/T-to-destination adapter is required and should be confirmed.

risks.duty: Duty / VAT rates change frequently — verify current figures with official customs before trading.
risks.age: Age-limit rules may be adjusted — confirm the current cut-off before sourcing stock.
risks.conformity: Conformity / certification requirements may change — confirm before shipment.
risks.charging: Charging-connector compatibility must be confirmed against the destination network.

checklist.age: Confirm the unit's production / registration date is within the destination age limit.
checklist.rhd: Confirm right-hand-drive availability with the exporter before purchase.
checklist.adapter: Confirm charging-adapter availability for the destination connector standard.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — China Used Car Export Markets
privacy.description: How the Markets sub-site handles information: a static reference for import rules and duties with no forms and no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how the Markets sub-site (part of China Used Auto Hub) handles information. This site is a static reference; it does not run forms or trackers.

p: The Markets sub-site is a reference for import rules, duties, taxes and shipping routes. It does not run contact or request forms and does not collect personal information through the site itself. If you contact us by email or WhatsApp, we receive only the details you choose to send.

We use information you send us solely to respond to your enquiry and to provide the sourcing and export services you request. We do not sell your information or share it with third parties for marketing.
Enquiries are kept only as long as needed to respond to you and to keep a record of the conversation. This site is static and does not run advertising or analytics trackers.

You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal data you have provided. We do not currently appoint a representative in any specific jurisdiction; our data practices are described here as they actually operate.
For privacy questions, email {email} or message us on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}.

terms.title: Terms of Use — China Used Car Export Markets
terms.description: Terms of use for the Markets sub-site: country market intelligence provided for reference, not legal advice.
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these terms. The Markets sub-site publishes country market intelligence as part of China Used Auto Hub.

p: The Markets sub-site publishes country market intelligence for exporting used cars from China — import rules, duties, taxes, drive-side rules, ports and shipping routes. It is provided for information and comparison.

Regulatory and tax information is compiled from official and public sources and is presented for reference. Rules, rates and requirements can change, and the figures shown may not be current for your shipment.
Nothing on this site is legal, tax, customs or import advice. For decisions with legal or financial consequences, consult a qualified adviser and the relevant destination-country authorities.
We work to keep market information accurate and current, but we do not guarantee that it is free of errors or omissions, and it may differ from what the authorities apply in practice.
Unless mandatory law in your jurisdiction provides otherwise, these terms and your use of this website are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.
For questions about these terms, email {email}.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy — China Used Car Export Markets
cookies.description: Cookie policy for the Markets sub-site: a static site with no tracking cookies, no analytics and no consent banner required.
cookies.intro: This page describes the cookies used on this website.

p: This site is a static reference and does not use advertising or analytics cookies. We do not set tracking cookies, advertising cookies or cross-site tracking identifiers.
Because this site sets no non-essential cookies and runs no third-party tracking scripts, it does not require a cookie-consent banner under data-protection rules that apply to non-essential cookies.
You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. This site does not depend on cookies for basic browsing, so disabling them should not affect your ability to use it.
For questions about this cookie policy, email {email}.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer — China Used Car Export Markets
disclaimer.description: Market information disclaimer: general guidance only, not legal advice, tax rates are dated and may change, and nothing here is an official quote.
disclaimer.intro: The market information on this website is provided for general information only.

p: Nothing on this site is legal, tax, customs or import advice. Import rules, duties, taxes and requirements can change at any time, and the authorities of the destination country — not this website — have the final say on what applies to your shipment. Consult a qualified adviser and the relevant destination-country authorities before relying on any information here.

Duty and tax rates shown on this site are recorded on the date shown with each item, and they may be out of date or may not reflect current rates, exemptions or your vehicle's specific classification. Always confirm current rates with the destination customs authority.

Figures on this site are informational references, not official quotes, valuations or offers. They do not bind any authority, supplier or broker, and they do not constitute a commitment to any price, duty or tax.
Before transacting, verify current rules, rates and requirements with the relevant authorities in your destination country. Figures can change and may differ from what is shown.
If you believe information here is incorrect or out of date, email {email} or message us on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}.
